svg.title: TraceMind full architecture — refined
svg.desc: Signals flow from sources through the REST API, validation, and sanitization. Sanitization independently persists accepted signals to PostgreSQL and enqueues an ingestion job to the reliable queue. Workers pull from the queue, then correlate signals, manage incidents, and route into a hybrid analysis engine where deterministic rules are primary and OpenAI is a no-match fallback, updating PostgreSQL. Payload configuration and PostgreSQL exchange allow-list data bidirectionally, incident management both creates/merges incidents in and reads from PostgreSQL, retention workers clean up signals and incidents in PostgreSQL, and health metrics summarize the queue, workers, and incidents via the REST health endpoint.
